Package dev.relism.flash.ext.data.core

Class ResourceTxManager<R>

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.ext.data.core.ResourceTxManager<R>
All Implemented Interfaces:
TxManager, AutoCloseable
Direct Known Subclasses:
HibernateTxManager, JdbcTxManager
public abstract class ResourceTxManager<R> extends Object implements TxManager
The propagation rules of a TxManager over one resource per transaction, a connection or a session, bound to the current thread. A backend says how its resource is acquired, begun, committed, rolled back and released; joining, suspending, resuming and firing the synchronizations are done here, the same for every backend.

A failure of a hook leaves as it was thrown when unchecked, wrapped in TxException when checked.

    • commit

      public void commit(TxStatus status)
      Commits a new transaction, or rolls it back if marked rollback-only. An exception before or during commit triggers a rollback attempt; a rollback exception is suppressed on the original. Completion callbacks can also throw. Completing a joined scope leaves the transaction open.
      Specified by:
      commit in interface TxManager
